title: Lost Mary BM600 Blackberry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Blackberry Ice Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods mix bold berry with a cool edge. Dark, juicy Blackberry delivers a sweet yet tart base, rounded off by an icy finish for a crisp and refreshing vape. Each pack includes two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, with up to 600 puffs per pod depending on use. With a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw, these pods provide dependable flavour without mess or maintenance. Made exclusively for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, the pods click into place easily, ready to deliver a balanced fruit-and-ice vape.
